name: Tsumuribe Kiriwo
source:
One of the protagonist’s seniors who has a shady aura about him. He’s the sole heir to the TSUMURI conglomerate, a major corporation, and is characterised by his elegant speech and conduct. Though he seems to have a striking smile plastered on his face, he isn’t good at expressing his own emotions and never goes on stage during theatre club activities. He often does things unbefitting of his social class behind his grandfather’s back.

‘Do not be so frightened… I want us to be on good terms.’
‘What a pity. I am quite easy to get along with, you know?’

[Translated from [url=https://twitter.com/mekakare_love]the official Twitter[/url].]
